note: AD2.1 -- a realistic evalset for measuring real per-invocation cost CV/skew. 36 cases across 3 genuinely-different complexity tiers (12/tier), not near-identical prompts -- tier A is short factual recall, tier B is short synthesis/reasoning, tier C is multi-step or longer-form generation. Complexity varies by task DEMAND (what the model has to produce), not just by input prompt length, so both prompt and completion token counts should vary for real reasons.

cases.prompt: What is the capital of France?
What is 17 plus 26?
Who wrote Romeo and Juliet?
What is the chemical symbol for gold?
What year did World War 2 end?
Name the largest planet in our solar system.
What is the square root of 144?
What language is primarily spoken in Brazil?
Who painted the Mona Lisa?
What is the boiling point of water in Celsius?
How many continents are there?
What is the currency of Japan?
Explain in a short paragraph why the sky appears blue.
Compare and contrast summer and winter in three to four sentences.
Write a short four-line poem about the ocean.
Summarize the plot of Cinderella in about five sentences.
Explain the difference between a crocodile and an alligator in a short paragraph.
Give three reasons why exercise is good for mental health, with a brief explanation for each.
Explain how a rainbow forms, in about four sentences.
Describe the basic rules of chess in a short paragraph.
Explain why leaves change color in autumn, in a short paragraph.
Write a short paragraph comparing coffee and tea.
Explain the water cycle in about four sentences.
Give a short explanation of how vaccines work.
Write a 250-300 word essay on the main causes of World War 1, covering at least three distinct factors.
Provide a step-by-step derivation of the quadratic formula starting from ax^2+bx+c=0, explaining each algebraic step.
Draft a detailed 5-phase project plan for building a personal portfolio website, with 2-3 tasks under each phase.
Explain the process of photosynthesis in detail, covering both the light-dependent and light-independent reactions, in at least 200 words.
Write a detailed comparison (at least 200 words) of monarchy, democracy, and dictatorship as forms of government, covering how power is acquired and limited in each.
Explain, step by step, how a bill becomes a law in the United States Congress, covering at least 6 distinct stages.
Write a detailed 200+ word explanation of how the human immune system responds to a viral infection, covering innate and adaptive immunity.
Provide a detailed, step-by-step explanation of how a car engine's four-stroke combustion cycle works.
Write a 200+ word analysis of the economic causes and consequences of the 2008 financial crisis.
Explain in detail, step by step, how public-key cryptography allows two parties to exchange a message securely without meeting in person.
Write a detailed 200+ word explanation of the plot, main themes, and central conflict of Shakespeare's Hamlet.
Provide a step-by-step, at least 200-word explanation of how a large language model is trained, from data collection through fine-tuning.
